source: out-of-fold probe readings (random 5-fold) of every place, labelled with its real country
caveat: Countries with many places in the list (e.g. the US, the UK, India, Australia) win more neighbour votes and grow; countries with few places shrink or vanish. The map shows the model's beliefs as read by a linear probe, filtered through the place list's coverage.

settings.radius_rule: land share closest to the real land share (Antarctica excluded)
